title: YouTube AdFree
shortDescription: Development build with on-TV feed diagnostics and hardened ad blocking.
description: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. It keeps the release ad-blocking, Shorts-removal, sponsored-overlay, and playback-hook hardening, and adds a blue-button diagnostics screen that snapshots feed schema information useful for identifying new or changed masthead/promotion renderer shapes. Diagnostics record only schema/key names and object paths, not payload values.

added: Blue-button GTV diagnostics screen with a compact frozen snapshot of feed-ad schema observations.
Unknown/suspicious renderer-key capture with object paths, nearby key names, Home leading-item shapes, and simple filter counters.
changed: Development branding inverts the final launcher and Homebrew Channel icon colors for unmistakable visual identification.
fixed: Sponsored Home masthead and feed ads escaping AdBlock during fresh app loads or alternate response schemas.
The playback JSON hook so unrelated JSON.stringify calls keep native behavior and avoid unnecessary deep cloning.
